# Rework round 5 — claims (alterations_and_tailoring, renderer source items)

- Render item 1 (premium_garment_addition rested on the sale-work allowance) → the premium-garment ladder now reads only the purchase's regular price. The rule that no waiver is given without a sale-work allowance moved to the complimentary result's assembly and the combining sentence.
- Render item 2 (factor tiers read another factor's bindings) → complimentary_waiver_form and quote_tolerance_form now read the membership tier through their own reads. wedding_party_credit reads the Wedding Registry event date through its own binding instead of the proximity factor's. A mechanical listing over all seven policies confirms that no factor reads a binding owned by another factor, either directly or through plumbing bindings.
- Render item 3 (rush fee waiver assembled inside a factor binding) → member_waiver_form now decides only which form applies: co-pay, per-operation or standard. The waiver's assembly (co-pay subtraction, reliefs, per-operation amount, standard whole-or-nothing, cap at the rush fee) lives in the result and in the combining sentence. The same separation was applied to the deposit form, the quote tolerance form and the complimentary form: each method factor names its form, and the result assembles the amount.
- Render item 4 (lined-surcharge overwrite without scope) → its replaced_by now opens with "for a complimentary waiver this policy books, and only for such a waiver" and ends by leaving every other complimentary waiver under the base rule. Class sweep: every overwrite in every policy now carries both the scoping opening and a closing tail; the deposit payment-timing overwrite was also given its scoping opening.
- Render item 5 (book_extra_fitting docstring claimed a booking) → the docstring, the Returns text and the confirmation message now say that the call records the extra fitting fee with the fitting's number, and that it sets no date or time. Tool name and signature are unchanged. Class sweep: every other task tool's stated effect matches its body (one row created, balance moved). The task 1 persona and proof text now say the shop sets the fitting time.
- Render item 6 (stale base parameter descriptions) → base text; not changed, as instructed.
- Render item 7 (three or more uncollected-pickup refunds undefined) → the uncollected-order addition now states that three or more refunds give no addition, because they put the deposit in the per-operation form, which uses no rate.
- O-R4-1 (deposit compute error for a class without a deposit) → the deposit result is guarded so such a class returns no deposit. Scope guards were added in the same sweep: the rush fee result applies only to a ticket accepted with rush service, and the added-work lining result applies only when the latest operation was booked after drop-off and an operation still lacks its surcharge. Each guard matches its policy's own scope sentence.
- Scored values → none moved in either task. Trees, edges, load-bearing effects, factor sensitivities and fall-backs are unchanged, and proof texts were re-swept to the restructured wording.
